name: Sinchana
bioHeadline: Sinchana, Full-Stack & AI Software Developer and CSE undergrad based in Bengaluru, India. Open to engineering roles and founder collaborations.
bioExtended: Building intuitive, high-impact web and AI systems from first principles. Turning complex domain problems into clean, production-ready interfaces.
aboutText: I’m a computer science undergrad in Bengaluru who builds full-stack and AI products. I care about typography, layout hierarchy and minimal aesthetics, and I design every interface myself, from the type scale to the hover states, so the product looks as considered as it works.
